caption: The drawing depicts a four-drawer wooden dresser, rendered in shades of brown, with visible wood grain patterns on each drawer and side. The dresser has a rectangular shape and stands on four turned legs, which are darker at the bottom. Each of the four drawers features two round knobs as handles; the top drawer is slightly shorter in height than the three lower drawers. Vertical wooden columns are present at each front corner, and the top surface is flat and bordered by a slightly protruding edge. The background is plain, off-white, and empty, drawing attention solely to the dresser without additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Chest of Drawers
